text:
tyler: Noticed KV-cache thrash during an EU recompute started 02:00 UTC. Production tail latency spiked. Thinking we need an operator-only soft-reserve for backfills.

mara: Can you paste a tiny log and the job config?

tyler: log snippet:
[2026-03-20T02:07:12Z] backfill[id=bf-eu-01] eviction=842 tail_ms=340
[2026-03-20T02:09:03Z] prod-read tail_ms=910
config: window=2026-03-18/2026-03-19, concurrency=24, queue=backfill-high.

kevin: Proposal: reserve_slots but soft: min_slot_lease + weight bump + preemptible if SLOs slip. Gate reserve_slots to role=operator.

sarah: Billing question: do reserved runs consume tenant quota or bill to platform? We should default to platform for ops runs. Finance must approve.

tyler: Also, recomputes re-emit metrics and pollute dashboards. Add suppress_metric_reemit or tag metrics with source=backfill.

mara: API sketch?

kevin: POST /v1/backfills {"tenant":"acme-eu","window":"2026-03-18/19","concurrency":24,"priority_override":"operator","reserve_slots":true,"min_slot_lease":1800,"suppress_metric_reemit":true,"backfill_charge_to":"platform"}

kevin: Runtime: Guardian.reserve_slots(min_slot_lease) renews while progress > 1/s; on SLO breach, preempt after preempt_timeout and emit audit event.

sarah: Console: require two-step confirm for operator overrides and show a visible badge "operator override active" plus billing target.

tyler: Canary plan: 1 tenant, 2h, reserve_slots=true, min_slot_lease=1800, suppress_metric_reemit=true. Acceptance: no production tail regression and KV evictions <50/min.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started canary bf-canary-eu-1 on eu-staging with reserve_slots=true

kevin: I'll open API PR and runtime guardian. mara please add runbook entry for operator overrides and rollback (guardian.force_release).

mara: Will do. Also add note to observability to filter source=backfill to avoid alert fatigue.

sarah: Looping in finance and secops.

tyler: Thanks — check back in ~30m for canary results. :eyes:
